name: Uptime Kuma
description: Self-hosted monitoring tool for tracking uptime of websites, APIs, and services with a beautiful UI.

env.label: Allow iFrame Embedding
env.description: Set to 1 to allow embedding the status page in iframes on other sites

env.label: Extra CA Certificates
env.description: Path to file with extra CA certificates for monitoring HTTPS endpoints with custom CAs

env.label: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
env.description: Cloudflare Tunnel token for exposing Uptime Kuma via Cloudflare Tunnel

env.label: Notification Proxy URL
env.description: Proxy URL for outgoing notification requests (e.g. http://proxy:8080)
